subject: Re: Mutual action plan + acceptance checkpoints for NovaBank evaluation
body:
From: Alicia Torres <alicia@novabank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elliot Grant <elliot.grant@novabank.com>, NovaBank Procurement <procurement@novabank.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan + acceptance checkpoints for NovaBank evaluation

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the demo last week. We want to lock a short mutual action plan so our security/compliance review and procurement can finish within the next three weeks. Key asks from our side: SOC 2 evidence index, completed SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet, DPA redline and your proposed data-retention window for pilot data.

Can you propose milestones with owners and target dates (SOC 2 evidence handoff, SIG responses, DPA redline, pilot start + data retention acceptance)? Procurement needs any binding SLA exceptions documented for the pilot.

Appreciate a compact MAP we can attach to the PO.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Torres
Head of Cloud Security Evaluation, NovaBank
[Attachment: evaluation-template.xlsx (Excel)]

-----

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@novabank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Connor OBrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Elliot Grant <elliot.grant@novabank.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + acceptance checkpoints for NovaBank evaluation

Alicia — thanks, excited to move this forward. Draft MAP below (short and prescriptive). I put owners and the minimal acceptance criteria we believe will unblock procurement.

Mutual Action Plan (draft)
- Kickoff & demo follow-up: complete (done)
- SOC 2 evidence index: deliver by 2026-11-18 (Owner: Kimberly Park, Redwood)
  - Includes: control mappings, audit report excerpts, responsibility matrix, encryption & key management notes
  - Acceptance: NovaBank security to confirm receipt and mark any follow-ups within 48h
- SIG/CAIQ responses: deliver completed spreadsheet by 2026-11-19 (Owner: Connor OBrien, Redwood)
  - Acceptance: Rows with >90% coverage are treated as satisfied for pilot gating; open items logged with risk and mitigation plan
- DPA redline: returnable redline by 2026-11-18 for negotiation (Owner: Irene Choi)
  - Acceptance checkpoint: Procurement review and initial redline approval window (3 business days)
- Pilot data retention & access: propose 90-day retention by default; optional 30/14-day windows for limited datasets (Owner: Product Ops)
  - Acceptance: NovaBank signs-off on retention window before pilot start
- Pilot start: targeting 2026-11-22 (dependent on DPA acknowledgment and SOC2/SIG deliverables)

Attachments I will send in the next email: SOC2-evidence-index.pdf, SIG-CAIQ-responses.xlsx, DPA-redline-Novabank.docx.

Do these dates work on your side? If you need a compressed path we can shift SIG to parallel work and extend SOC2 follow-ups into a 2-week post-pilot remediation list (we prefer to keep core gating docs first).

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

-----

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@novabank.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor OBrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + acceptance checkpoints for NovaBank evaluation

Alicia — attaching the SOC2 evidence index. Quick notes:
- We can provide the full auditor report excerpts (redacted client names) and control mappings.
- For key management, we support customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS in Dedicated and VPC deployments; for hosted, we use KMS with envelope encryption.
- For pilot acceptance, recommend NovaBank signs an evidence receipt doc after initial review — that prevents open-item drift.

[Attachment: SOC2-evidence-index.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]

Irene: I set flagged items that will need a short remediation plan if the auditor requires it — call out from your side if we should expand or compress.

-Kimberly

-----

From: Connor OBrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@novabank.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + acceptance checkpoints for NovaBank evaluation

Hi all — attached SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet is complete for the evaluation scope (pilot-level questions). Highlights:
- 85% yes/partial across pilot-relevant controls; 9 rows require further engineering confirmation (listed in tab 'OpenItems').
- Suggested gating: proceed with pilot if NovaBank accepts the documented mitigations and a remediation timeline is established (we propose 30 days post-pilot to close engineering items).

[Attachment: SIG-CAIQ-responses.xlsx (Excel, 320KB)]

Irene: adding brief notes to the MAP about open-engineering items and our proposed 30-day remediation window.

Connor

-----

From: NovaBank Procurement <procurement@novabank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Alicia Torres <alicia@novabank.com>
Cc: Elliot Grant <elliot.grant@novabank.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + acceptance checkpoints for NovaBank evaluation

Thanks everyone — procurement confirms the MAP items are sufficient to prepare a PO and we will route the DPA to legal once we have Irene's redline. Two asks before we finalize:
1) Please confirm pilot SLA (latency SLO and uptime target) that procurement can reference — if you can provide the small SLA addendum we can sign it into the PO.
2) Confirm authoritative contact for SOC2 follow-ups (name/email) for audit clarifications.

Irene/Kimberly: once those two items are in we will circulation the PO and target a pilot start on 2026-11-22 as discussed.

Procurement Team
NovaBank
[Signed: Procurement Intake ID 87421]

-----

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: NovaBank Procurement <procurement@novabank.com>, Alicia Torres <alicia@novabank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Connor OBrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + acceptance checkpoints for NovaBank evaluation

Thanks — confirming two quick items:
- Pilot SLA addendum: attached (SLA-addendum-pilot.txt) with latency SLO 95th pct < 180ms for the configured route and uptime target 99.5% for the pilot window.
- SOC2 follow-up contact: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>. She will be the point for evidence questions.

Also attached: DPA redline for your review. We marked core carveouts needed for pilot telemetry. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if legal wants to walk the redline.

Attachments: DPA-redline-Novabank.docx, SLA-addendum-pilot.txt

Best,
Irene

[End of thread]
